title: Saving a new description changes it at every location and on its core
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DESCSAVE-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Desc Save) and a Core Charge (for example 15.00), is stocked at {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
  • The new description is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Desc Saved New).
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  6. Type Core for {Description-B} in the Part Library search.
  7. Pick {Location-B} in the location switcher.
  8. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the window closes, and the {Location-A} row shows {Description-B}.
  • Step 5: the one entry shows Description {Description-B}.
  • Step 6: the core entry reads "Core for {Description-B}".
  • Step 8: at {Location-B} the row also shows {Description-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R14, S13-R15, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.3 (Saved: the list shows the new values), board 2.5 (Lethbridge: renamed there too), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R14: “Saving a changed description changes the part's Part Library entry, so every location that stocks the part shows the new description.”
  • S13-R15: “A changed description also renames the part's core, which reads "Core for {description}".”
